dict.string: Notchling shows your upcoming events and meeting links in the notch. It never creates, edits or deletes events.
Notchling watches your screenshot folder so new screenshots and recordings appear in Clips.
Notchling can sync your tasks with a “Notchling” list in Reminders so they reach your iPhone and Apple Watch.
Notchling listens only while you hold the mic button, to add a task by voice.
Notchling turns what you say into a task. Recognition runs on your Mac when your language supports it.
Notchling shows a private camera preview so you can check yourself before a meeting. Nothing is recorded.
Notchling uses your location with Apple Maps to tell you when to leave for events.

Notchling opens Terminal to connect Claude Code when you ask it to.
